blocks.zh: 完整性保證、規格與試驗方法選擇
blocks.en: Integrity Assurance, Specifications and Test Method Selection

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives — 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Understand the three phases of package integrity quality assurance: design/development, in-process control, and product testing (了解包裝完整性品質保證的三個階段)
blocks.en: Understand the three phases of package integrity quality assurance: design/development, in-process control, and product testing

blocks.zh: Interpret leak rate units (std cc/s, atm cc/s, Pa m³/s) and their interconversion (解讀洩漏率單位及其換算關係)
blocks.en: Interpret leak rate units (std cc/s, atm cc/s, Pa m³/s) and their interconversion

blocks.zh: Distinguish seals from closures and explain how each limits leakage (區分密封與封蓋，並說明各自限制洩漏的原理)
blocks.en: Distinguish seals from closures and explain how each limits leakage

blocks.zh: Apply the concept of critical leak size to microbial ingress and liquid passage (應用關鍵洩漏尺寸概念於微生物入侵及液體穿透判斷)
blocks.en: Apply the concept of critical leak size to microbial ingress and liquid passage

blocks.zh: Select appropriate leak test methods based on sensitivity range and product life cycle stage (依靈敏度範圍與產品生命週期階段選擇適當試驗方法)
blocks.en: Select appropriate leak test methods based on sensitivity range and product life cycle stage

blocks.zh: Contents — 本節目錄
blocks.en: Contents

blocks.zh: 包裝設計、製程開發與耐久性評估
blocks.en: Package Design, Process Development and Durability Evaluation

blocks.zh: Original Text — 原文
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 包裝完整性生命週期階段 — Package Integrity Lifecycle Phases
blocks.en: Package Integrity Lifecycle Phases

blocks.zh: TR27 將包裝完整性品質保證分為三個連續階段，彼此相輔相成：
blocks.en: TR27 divides package integrity quality assurance into three sequential phases that complement one another:

blocks.zh: 階段一：包裝設計與製程開發 — 選材、密封設計、規格建立、耐久性評估
blocks.en: Phase 1: Package design and process development — material selection, seal design, specification setting, durability evaluation

blocks.zh: 階段二：製程中管控 (In-Process Control) — 關鍵製程參數監控、線上完整性驗證
blocks.en: Phase 2: In-process control — monitoring of critical process parameters, in-line integrity verification

blocks.zh: 階段三：產品測試 (Product Testing) — 最終產品抽樣檢驗、間接完整性指標
blocks.en: Phase 3: Product testing — final product sampling and testing, indirect integrity indicators

blocks.zh: 設計階段投入越充分，商業化後問題越少。這是 TR27 的核心哲學。
blocks.en: The more effort invested at the design stage, the fewer problems after commercialization. This is the core philosophy of TR27.

blocks.zh: 密封 vs. 封蓋 — Seal vs. Closure
blocks.en: Seal vs. Closure

blocks.zh: 密封 (Seal)：兩個表面的結合（熔合、黏接），結合後成為連續整體，例如安瓿、熱封袋、泡殼包裝。
blocks.en: Seal: the joining of two surfaces (fusion or adhesion) so that they become one continuous whole, for example ampoules, heat-sealed pouches and blister packs.

blocks.zh: 封蓋 (Closure)：兩個表面的物理配合，本質上是「曲折路徑屏障 (tortuous path barrier)」，例如橡皮塞小瓶、旋蓋瓶。
blocks.en: Closure: the physical fit of two surfaces, which is essentially a "tortuous path barrier", for example stoppered vials and screw-cap bottles.

blocks.zh: 橡皮塞之所以能達到極低洩漏率，是因為橡膠的黏彈性 (viscoelastic nature) 使其受壓後能緊密貼合瓶口，自動填補微小間隙。
blocks.en: A rubber stopper can achieve a very low leak rate because the viscoelastic nature of rubber lets it conform tightly to the vial neck under compression, automatically filling microscopic gaps.

blocks.zh: 關鍵製程變數 — Critical Process Variables
blocks.en: Critical Process Variables

blocks.zh: 影響包裝密封品質的關鍵變數包括：
blocks.en: Key variables that affect package seal quality include:

blocks.zh: 組件變數：材質組成、尺寸、關鍵缺陷
blocks.en: Component variables: material composition, dimensions, critical defects

blocks.zh: 密封操作變數：時間、溫度、壓力、扭力
blocks.en: Sealing operation variables: time, temperature, pressure, torque

blocks.zh: 加工影響：清洗、乾燥、矽化、滅菌（包含終端滅菌）
blocks.en: Processing effects: washing, drying, siliconization, sterilization (including terminal sterilization)

blocks.zh: 在驗證研究中，應刻意將各關鍵變數推至極端值，以界定安全邊界 (margin of safety)。
blocks.en: In validation studies, each critical variable should be deliberately pushed to its extremes to define the margin of safety.

blocks.zh: 實務比喻 — Real-World Analogy
blocks.en: Real-World Analogy

blocks.zh: 橡皮塞封蓋就像冰箱門的橡膠密封條：冰箱門關上時，橡膠受壓變形並填滿邊框間隙，形成近乎氣密的封閉。若橡膠老化（材質劣化）或門框變形（尺寸偏差），密封就會失效。包裝完整性也是同樣道理。
blocks.en: A rubber stopper closure works like the rubber gasket on a refrigerator door: when the door closes, the rubber is compressed and deforms to fill the gap around the frame, creating a near-airtight enclosure. If the rubber ages (material degradation) or the door frame warps (dimensional deviation), the seal fails. Package integrity works on the same principle.

blocks.zh: 製程中管控
blocks.en: In-Process Control

blocks.zh: 製程中管控的核心邏輯
blocks.en: Core Logic of In-Process Control

blocks.zh: In-process control 的目標是驗證「製程在管控中」，而非直接驗證最終產品品質。其邏輯鏈為：
blocks.en: The goal of in-process control is to verify that the "process is in control", rather than to verify final product quality directly. The logic chain is:

blocks.zh:
製程關鍵變數受控
(Time, Temp, Pressure, Torque)
blocks.en:
Critical process variables under control
(Time, Temp, Pressure, Torque)

blocks.zh: 驗證研究確認「受控製程 = 符規產品」
blocks.en: Validation studies confirm "controlled process = conforming product"

blocks.zh: 產品符合洩漏率規格
blocks.en: Product meets the leak rate specification

blocks.zh: 線上完整性測試的侷限性
blocks.en: Limitations of In-Line Integrity Testing

blocks.zh: 許多無菌產品的線上洩漏測試儀器無法達到產品所需的洩漏率規格靈敏度。這些儀器只能偵測「大漏」（gross leak），用於剔除明顯缺陷品，而非完整性定量驗證。
blocks.en: For many sterile products, in-line leak test instruments cannot reach the sensitivity needed for the product's leak rate specification. These instruments can only detect gross leaks and are used to reject obviously defective units, not to provide quantitative integrity verification.

blocks.zh: 重要觀念：沒有任何測試可以取代對關鍵製程參數的監控與管制。測試是最後一道防線，不是第一道。
blocks.en: Key concept: no test can replace the monitoring and control of critical process parameters. Testing is the last line of defense, not the first.

blocks.zh: 工廠實務比喻
blocks.en: Shop-Floor Analogy

blocks.zh: In-process control 就像生產線上的即時溫度警報：即使你無法在線上直接量測每支成品的密封強度，只要確保熱封溫度始終在 180±5°C，驗證資料就已證明這個條件下生產的產品必然符合規格。
blocks.en: In-process control is like a real-time temperature alarm on a production line: even if you cannot measure the seal strength of every finished unit in-line, as long as the heat-seal temperature is always held at 180±5°C, the validation data have already shown that product made under this condition will meet specification.

blocks.zh: 產品測試
blocks.en: Product Testing

blocks.zh: 無菌測試不等於完整性驗證
blocks.en: Sterility Testing Is Not Integrity Verification

blocks.zh: TR27 明確指出：無菌測試 (sterility test) 歷史上曾被視為包裝完整性的指標，但現在已不被認為是可靠的最終指標，原因如下：
blocks.en: TR27 states clearly that the sterility test was historically regarded as an indicator of package integrity but is no longer considered a reliable final indicator, for the following reasons:

blocks.zh: 靈敏度不足：無菌測試只能偵測微生物，無法量化洩漏率
blocks.en: Insufficient sensitivity: a sterility test can only detect microorganisms and cannot quantify leak rate

blocks.zh: 樣本數過少：抽樣比例遠不足以代表整批
blocks.en: Too few samples: the sampling rate is far too small to represent the whole batch

blocks.zh: 偽陽性風險：操作污染可能導致錯誤判讀
blocks.en: Risk of false positives: handling contamination may lead to incorrect results

blocks.zh: 間接完整性測試 — Indirect Integrity Tests
blocks.en: Indirect Integrity Tests

blocks.zh: 間接測試不直接量測洩漏，而是透過替代指標推斷密封品質：
blocks.en: Indirect tests do not measure leakage directly; they infer seal quality from surrogate indicators:

blocks.zh: 殘留密封力 (Residual Seal Force, RSF)：量測橡皮塞對瓶口施加的壓縮力，反映密封完整性
blocks.en: Residual Seal Force (RSF): measures the compressive force the stopper exerts on the vial neck, reflecting seal integrity

blocks.zh: 密封強度 (Seal Strength)：剝離或拉伸測試，適用於熱封或黏著密封
blocks.en: Seal Strength: peel or tensile testing, suitable for heat seals or adhesive seals

blocks.zh: 目視檢查：偵測可見缺陷，靈敏度最低但最常用
blocks.en: Visual inspection: detects visible defects; the least sensitive method but the most commonly used

blocks.zh: 這些間接測試的接受標準必須回溯至設計階段建立的關鍵變數可接受範圍。
blocks.en: The acceptance criteria for these indirect tests must be traceable back to the acceptable ranges of critical variables established during the design stage.

blocks.zh: 包裝完整性與洩漏率規格
blocks.en: Package Integrity and Leak Rate Specifications

blocks.zh: 洩漏率單位換算 — Leak Rate Unit Conversion
blocks.en: Leak Rate Unit Conversion

blocks.zh: 三種常見洩漏率單位及其關係：
blocks.en: Three common leak rate units and how they relate:

blocks.zh:
1 Pa m³/s ≈ 9.87 scc/s ≈ 10 scc/s

std cc/s (scc/s)
  = 氣體在標準條件（101.3 kPa, 20°C）下
    每秒通過開口的體積（cm³）

atm cc/s
  = 在當地大氣壓條件下量測
  ≈ scc/s（常互換使用，但嚴格說來不同）

Pa m³/s（SI 單位）
  = 國際標準單位，精確換算為 9.87 scc/s
blocks.en:
1 Pa m³/s ≈ 9.87 scc/s ≈ 10 scc/s

std cc/s (scc/s)
  = volume of gas (cm³) passing through the opening
    per second under standard conditions (101.3 kPa, 20°C)

atm cc/s
  = measured at local atmospheric pressure
  ≈ scc/s (often used interchangeably, though strictly different)

Pa m³/s (SI unit)
  = international standard unit; converts exactly to 9.87 scc/s

blocks.zh: 記憶訣竅：Pa m³/s ≈ 10 × scc/s，在工程估算中可直接換算。
blocks.en: Rule of thumb: Pa m³/s ≈ 10 × scc/s, which can be used directly for engineering estimates.

blocks.zh: 洩漏率與物理現象的對應
blocks.en: Leak Rates and Physical Phenomena

blocks.zh: TR27 提供了一個非常直觀的洩漏率尺度，幫助建立量級感：
blocks.en: TR27 provides an intuitive leak rate scale to help build a sense of magnitude:

blocks.zh: 1 scc/s：可聽見聲音 — 肉眼可見的大漏
blocks.en: 1 scc/s: audible sound — a gross leak visible to the naked eye

blocks.zh: 0.1 scc/s：可見液體流動 — 目視可偵測
blocks.en: 0.1 scc/s: visible liquid flow — detectable by visual inspection

blocks.zh: 10−3 scc/s：臨界洩漏尺寸 (Critical Leak Size) — 水無法穿透的邊界，也是微生物無法穿透的邊界
blocks.en: 10−3 scc/s: critical leak size — the boundary below which water cannot pass, and also the boundary below which microorganisms cannot pass

blocks.zh: 10−11 scc/s：氦質譜儀的偵測下限 — 目前最靈敏的洩漏測試方法
blocks.en: 10−11 scc/s: detection limit of the helium mass spectrometer — currently the most sensitive leak test method

blocks.zh: 關鍵洩漏尺寸 — Critical Leak Size
blocks.en: Critical Leak Size

blocks.zh: 10<sup>−3</sup> scc/s 是包裝完整性中最重要的基準值：
blocks.en: 10<sup>−3</sup> scc/s is the most important benchmark value in package integrity:

blocks.zh: 水（液體）無法穿過允許 <10<sup>−3</sup> scc/s 空氣流量的孔隙（差壓約 1 atm）
blocks.en: Water (liquid) cannot pass through a pore that allows an air flow of <10<sup>−3</sup> scc/s (at a pressure differential of about 1 atm)

blocks.zh: 微生物（液態傳播）也無法穿透小於液體穿透臨界值的裂縫
blocks.en: Microorganisms (carried in liquid) also cannot pass through a defect smaller than the critical size for liquid penetration

blocks.zh: 因此，無菌液體產品及滅菌粉末、凍乾品的洩漏率規格上限，通常設定在 10<sup>−3</sup> scc/s 以下
blocks.en: Therefore, the upper limit of the leak rate specification for sterile liquid products, sterile powders and lyophilized products is usually set at or below 10<sup>−3</sup> scc/s

blocks.zh: 科學依據：Kirsch et al. 和 Morton (1989) 實驗性地確立了氣體流量、液體洩漏與液態微生物入侵之間的關係。
blocks.en: Scientific basis: Kirsch et al. and Morton (1989) experimentally established the relationship between gas flow, liquid leakage and liquid-borne microbial ingress.

blocks.zh: 替代洩漏率表示方式
blocks.en: Alternative Ways to Express Leak Rate

blocks.zh: 並非所有洩漏都必須以氣體流量表示，以下替代方式同樣可接受：
blocks.en: Not every leak has to be expressed as gas flow; the following alternatives are equally acceptable:

blocks.zh: 重量損失/增加：如「產品在 35°C 儲存 2 年，每年損失 X 克」
blocks.en: Weight loss/gain: for example, "product loses X grams per year when stored at 35°C for 2 years"

blocks.zh: 頂部空間氧氣濃度上升：用於惰性氣體充填包裝
blocks.en: Rise in headspace oxygen concentration: used for inert gas-filled packages

blocks.zh: 染料遷移體積：用於染料浸入測試
blocks.en: Volume of dye migration: used for dye ingress tests

blocks.zh: 關鍵要求：必須清楚說明質量或體積流量與時間的關係，並標明測試條件。
blocks.en: Key requirement: the relationship between mass or volumetric flow and time must be clearly stated, and the test conditions must be specified.

blocks.zh: 試驗方法靈敏度
blocks.en: Test Method Sensitivity

blocks.zh: 靈敏度過高也是問題
blocks.en: Excessive Sensitivity Is Also a Problem

blocks.zh: TR27 明確警告：過度靈敏的方法同樣不適當，且代價高昂。
blocks.en: TR27 explicitly warns that an overly sensitive method is likewise inappropriate and costly.

blocks.zh: 對 HDPE 旋蓋瓶（裝片劑）使用氦質譜儀 = 殺雞用牛刀，浪費資源
blocks.en: Using a helium mass spectrometer on an HDPE screw-cap bottle (for tablets) = using a sledgehammer to crack a nut, a waste of resources

blocks.zh: 對洩漏率規格為 10<sup>−7</sup> scc/s 的產品使用微生物挑戰試驗 = 完全沒有意義（微生物試驗靈敏度遠高於此規格）
blocks.en: Using a microbial challenge test for a product with a leak rate specification of 10<sup>−7</sup> scc/s = meaningless (the sensitivity of microbial tests is far lower than this specification requires)

blocks.zh: 原則：選擇方法時，靈敏度應與產品的洩漏率規格匹配，過高過低都不對。
blocks.en: Principle: when selecting a method, its sensitivity should match the product's leak rate specification; neither too high nor too low is correct.

blocks.zh: 比喻 — 體溫計與 MRI
blocks.en: Analogy: Thermometer vs. MRI

blocks.zh: 選擇太靈敏的測試就像用 MRI 做例行體溫量測：功能強大，但完全不符合場合需求，且成本極高。同樣地，測試靈敏度必須配合產品的實際風險等級。
blocks.en: Choosing an overly sensitive test is like using an MRI for routine temperature measurement: powerful, but completely unsuited to the occasion and extremely costly. Likewise, test sensitivity must match the actual risk level of the product.

blocks.zh: 試驗方法靈敏度 vs. 特異性 — Sensitivity vs. Specificity
blocks.en: Test Method Sensitivity vs. Specificity

blocks.zh: 在洩漏測試中，靈敏度 (sensitivity) 與特異性 (specificity) 的概念如下：
blocks.en: In leak testing, the concepts of sensitivity and specificity are as follows:

blocks.zh: 其他試驗方法選擇考量
blocks.en: Other Considerations in Test Method Selection

blocks.zh: 試驗方法選擇的全面考量框架
blocks.en: A Comprehensive Framework for Test Method Selection

blocks.zh: 除靈敏度外，TR27 列出選擇洩漏測試方法時需考量的其他因素：
blocks.en: Besides sensitivity, TR27 lists the following factors to consider when selecting a leak test method:

blocks.zh: 技術適用性：方法是否能有效偵測該密封類型的洩漏
blocks.en: Technical suitability: whether the method can effectively detect leaks in that seal type

blocks.zh: 量測變異來源：包括操作員、環境、儀器精密度
blocks.en: Sources of measurement variability: including operator, environment and instrument precision

blocks.zh: 資料管理：是否支援資料儲存、統計分析、顯示功能
blocks.en: Data management: whether it supports data storage, statistical analysis and display functions

blocks.zh: 實用性與速度：是否適合生產線需求（高速 vs. 離線）
blocks.en: Practicality and speed: whether it suits production line needs (high-speed vs. off-line)

blocks.zh: 安全性：試劑毒性、高壓設備安全
blocks.en: Safety: toxicity of reagents, safety of high-pressure equipment

blocks.zh: 線上整合可行性：能否整合至現有生產設備
blocks.en: Feasibility of in-line integration: whether it can be integrated into existing production equipment

blocks.zh: 成本：設備投資、耗材、驗證成本
blocks.en: Cost: equipment investment, consumables, validation cost

blocks.zh: 物理測試 vs. 微生物挑戰試驗
blocks.en: Physical Tests vs. Microbial Challenge Tests

blocks.zh: 傳統上，無菌包裝完整性以微生物挑戰試驗驗證（氣態或液態浸入法）。但現代趨勢是以確定性物理測試 (Deterministic Physical Test)取代機率性微生物挑戰：
blocks.en: Traditionally, sterile package integrity was verified by microbial challenge tests (aerosol or liquid immersion methods). The modern trend, however, is to replace probabilistic microbial challenges with deterministic physical tests:

blocks.zh: 微生物挑戰試驗：有使用歷史，間接反映微生物屏障效果；但靈敏度受限，結果受微生物濃度、接觸時間等變數影響
blocks.en: Microbial challenge test: has a history of use and indirectly reflects microbial barrier effectiveness; however, its sensitivity is limited and results are affected by variables such as microbial concentration and exposure time

blocks.zh: 物理測試：量化洩漏率，可重複驗證，適合品質系統整合；FDA 及 USP <1207> 傾向支持物理測試取代微生物挑戰
blocks.en: Physical test: quantifies leak rate, is repeatable and verifiable, and integrates well into the quality system; FDA and USP <1207> tend to support replacing microbial challenge with physical testing

blocks.zh: 練習題 1 — Practice Question 1
blocks.en: Practice Question 1

blocks.zh: 一無菌凍乾粉針劑（橡皮塞+鋁蓋小瓶）計畫進行包裝完整性驗證。下列哪個階段最需要使用能偵測至洩漏率規格的精密物理測試方法？
blocks.en: A sterile lyophilized powder for injection (vial with rubber stopper and aluminum cap) is scheduled for package integrity validation. At which stage is a high-sensitivity physical test method capable of detecting down to the leak rate specification most needed?

blocks.zh: A. 商業生產線上剔除大漏品
blocks.en: A. Rejecting gross leakers on the commercial production line

blocks.zh: B. 包裝設計驗證與穩定性研究
blocks.en: B. Package design verification and stability studies

blocks.zh: C. 目視檢查例行抽樣
blocks.en: C. Routine visual inspection sampling

blocks.zh: D. 供應商組件進料檢驗
blocks.en: D. Incoming inspection of supplier components

blocks.zh: 答案：B — 設計驗證與穩定性研究需要確認包裝系統能維持在洩漏率規格以下，必須使用靈敏度達規格水準的精密測試方法。商業生產線（A）通常使用大漏偵測即可。
blocks.en: Answer: B — Design verification and stability studies must confirm that the packaging system stays below the leak rate specification, so a high-sensitivity test method that reaches the specification level is required. Commercial production lines (A) can usually rely on gross leak detection.

blocks.zh: 練習題 2 — Practice Question 2
blocks.en: Practice Question 2

blocks.zh: 某產品的洩漏率規格為 10<sup>−3</sup> scc/s（無菌液體產品）。以下哪種情況描述正確？
blocks.en: A product has a leak rate specification of 10<sup>−3</sup> scc/s (sterile liquid product). Which of the following statements is correct?

blocks.zh: A. 洩漏率低於 10<sup>−3</sup> scc/s 的包裝，液態水仍可能穿透並帶入微生物
blocks.en: A. For a package with a leak rate below 10<sup>−3</sup> scc/s, liquid water can still pass through and carry in microorganisms

blocks.zh: B. 洩漏率高於 10<sup>−3</sup> scc/s 的包裝，液態水無法穿透，微生物也無法入侵
blocks.en: B. For a package with a leak rate above 10<sup>−3</sup> scc/s, liquid water cannot pass through and microorganisms cannot enter

blocks.zh: C. 洩漏率低於 10<sup>−3</sup> scc/s 時，水無法穿透，微生物也無法液態傳播入侵
blocks.en: C. At a leak rate below 10<sup>−3</sup> scc/s, water cannot pass through and microorganisms cannot enter via liquid

blocks.zh: D. 10<sup>−3</sup> scc/s 是氦質譜儀的偵測下限
blocks.en: D. 10<sup>−3</sup> scc/s is the detection limit of the helium mass spectrometer

blocks.zh: 答案：C — TR27 根據 Kirsch et al. 研究：水無法穿透允許 <10−3 scc/s 空氣流量的孔隙（差壓 ~1 atm），微生物（液態傳播）同樣無法穿透。因此 10−3 scc/s 是液態屏障與微生物屏障的關鍵洩漏尺寸。氦質譜下限（D）是 10−11 scc/s，選項 A、B 均描述錯誤。
blocks.en: Answer: C — Based on the Kirsch et al. study cited in TR27: water cannot pass through a pore that allows an air flow of <10−3 scc/s (pressure differential ~1 atm), and microorganisms (carried in liquid) cannot pass either. Therefore 10−3 scc/s is the critical leak size for both the liquid barrier and the microbial barrier. The detection limit of the helium mass spectrometer (D) is 10−11 scc/s, and options A and B are both incorrect.
